select * from ( select row_number() over (order by file_id) as rn , file_id as file_id, file_name as file_name , extension as extension, size as size , hash as hash, update_time as update_time , f.path_id as file_path_id , fp.path_id as path_id , path, access_Id , depth, fp.parent_Id as parent_id from file_path fp join file f on fp.path_id=f.path_id where (f.path_id=#{idColumn} or parent_id=#{idColumn})
and file_name like concat('%',#{searchWord},'%')
and extension like concat('%',#{kind},'%')
) as sub where rn between #{startRow} and #{endRow} order by file_name
select path from file_path where path_id = #{pathId}
select count(*) from file f join file_path fp on f.path_id=fp.path_id where f.path_id=#{pathId}
